annotations.text:
The three shapes the dialog takes.

Everything above the rule decides which machine answers; everything below it describes the model. A provider that cannot act on a setting keeps the field and dims it, rather than dropping it — an absent field reads as a missing feature instead of one this route does not have.

Test reports a code and a duration, never the provider's own reply.

Colour carries the outcome and so does the wording, so the line still reads correctly in greyscale or to anyone who cannot separate the two tones.
